title: EVALUATING METRICS FOR BIAS IN WORD EMBEDDINGS

bias_targets.methodology: Inducing known gender biases by fine-tuning BERT on synthetic template sentences with masked pronouns (e.g., he/she, him/her) linked to specific occupations, and evaluating various cosine-based embedding metrics (WEAT, MAC, Direct Bias, SAME) on their ability to accurately quantify these embedded associations.
